name: What is the process for countertop replacement with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for countertop replacement with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our countertop replacement process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, material preferences, and budget. Next, we conduct an on-site measurement to create precise templates for your new countertops. Once your material is selected and fabricated, we schedule the installation, which involves removing your old countertops, preparing the surfaces, and meticulously installing the new ones. Finally, we ensure all necessary plumbing and fixtures are reconnected. We aim for clear communication and minimal disruption throughout the project, from initial design to final cleanup in the San Francisco Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, precise measurements, material fabrication, old countertop removal, new countertop installation, and fixture reconnection, ensuring clear communication throughout.
